audit.why: 50% over 58 packet games and 82 total; the content layer already reads as a knife-edge lane. Difficulty tag left alone per the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers handed Graves Levels 1, 2 and 3 and gave Levels 4-5 to Skill — the opposite of the packet chart and of this page's own whys.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Skill, Skill, Graves, Skill, Graves, Skill; the mirror set both charts to exactly that with Graves-side ratings 5,5,5,7,5,7,5. whys[0] to whys[2] describe even coin-flip trades, and whys[3] explicitly says True Grit plus his first item out-ranges you at 4-5.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 flipped in matched pairs; all seven ratings realigned to the inverse of the Graves page (5,5,5,3,5,3,5).

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is described four times as blinding your autos and stopping the passive root proc. It does not blind.
audit.why: Riot text: Smoke Screen creates a cloud that reduces sight range, and enemies caught in the initial impact take magic damage and are briefly slowed (26/24/22/20/18s). Nothing in it disables attacks — so it never stops Staggering Blow; it just keeps you from seeing and closing. Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s and its cooldown is lowered by his basic attacks, which the full layer never said. End of the Line detonates on terrain and can cut a retreat you have no dash to answer.
audit.corrected: whys[1], whys[3], spikes[1].text, wants.foe[1] and early rewritten to sight-cut-and-slow; dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d carry the real cooldowns; the terrain-cut-retreat note added to early.

edits.before: He can take W smoke screen to blind your autos or E to reposition; you have Q-into-root but no follow-up burst yet, so the trade hinges purely on whether your hook lands — genuinely even.
edits.after: He can take Smoke Screen to cut your sight and slow you, or E to reposition; you have Q-into-root but no burst yet, so the trade hinges purely on whether your hook lands — genuinely even.

edits.before: With True Grit and his early item, Graves out-ranges and out-bursts you — his shotgun blast plus W blind beats your low base damage while you still have no R to lock him down.
edits.after: With True Grit and his early item, Graves out-ranges and out-bursts you — his shotgun blast plus the Smoke Screen slow beats your base damage while you have no R to lock him down.

edits.before: Graves with True Grit and his E charges out-trades you if you whiff Q — his shotgun blast plus W smoke screen blinds your autos so you can't proc the passive root.
edits.after: Graves with True Grit and his E charges out-trades you if you whiff Q — his shotgun blast plus Smoke Screen's sight cut and slow keep you off the passive root.

edits.before: Keep W smoke screen up to blind your autos so you never proc the passive root that starts your chain
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen on you — it cuts your sight and slows, so you never reach the auto that roots

edits.before: Graves is a ranged skirmisher, so your whole early game is landing Q — Dredge Line is your only way to touch him. He will hold his E dash to dodge your hook and his W smoke screen blinds your autos so you can't proc the Staggering Blow passive root. Don't throw Q on cooldown into open ground where he just dashes it; bait the E first, walk him down behind minions, then hook into passive root and W splash burn. If you whiff the anchor, his shotgun blast and burst trade chunk you for free — this is a Skill matchup early because both of you live and die on one button.
edits.after: Graves is a ranged skirmisher, so your whole early game is landing Q — Dredge Line is your only way to touch him. He holds his E dash to dodge the hook, and Smoke Screen cuts your sight range and slows you off the Staggering Blow root rather than blinding you. Don't throw Q on cooldown into open ground where he just dashes it; bait the E first, walk him down behind minions, then hook into passive root and W splash burn. End of the Line detonates on terrain and can cut your retreat — you have no dash, so hold Flash for that wall, not for the damage.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 and his autos refresh it — engage once he has spent it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows, 26s at rank 1 — walk out of the cloud.

notes: The 'W blind' claim ran through four fields and is simply not in Graves' kit any more — Smoke Screen reduces sight range and slows on impact. That mattered because the page used it to explain why Staggering Blow does not proc, which is false. Ratings realigned to the inverse of the Graves-side numbers the mirror set.
